evidence.reason: The parser accepts `--seed` independently (line 2877), while both `drain-alive` and `drain-ambiguous` dispatch to the same `drain_refuse_phase(args)` with no phase/seed consistency check or derivation. A conflicting seed can therefore select a different probe than the phase name and file the result under the phase's evidence, so rejecting or deriving the seed before dispatch is a routine correctness fix.
